source.content: @isTest private class CoreRuntimeCacheStaticBulkEvidenceTest { @isTest static void bulkRows() { Cache.Org.put('org-one', 'one'); Cache.Org.put('org-two', 'two', 60); Cache.Org.put('org-three', 'three', 60, Cache.Visibility.ALL, false); Map<String,Boolean> orgContains = Cache.Org.contains(new Set<String>{'org-one', 'org-missing'}); System.assertEquals(true, orgContains.get('org-one')); System.assertEquals(false, orgContains.get('org-missing')); Map<String,Object> orgValues = Cache.Org.get(new Set<String>{'org-one', 'org-two'}); System.assertEquals('one', (String) orgValues.get('org-one')); System.assertEquals('two', (String) orgValues.get('org-two')); List<Boolean> orgListContains = Cache.Org.contains(new List<String>{'org-one', 'org-missing'}); System.assertEquals(true, orgListContains[0]); System.assertEquals(false, orgListContains[1]); List<Object> orgListValues = Cache.Org.get(new List<String>{'org-one', 'org-three'}); System.assertEquals('one', (String) orgListValues[0]); System.assertEquals('three', (String) orgListValues[1]); List<Boolean> removed = Cache.Org.remove(new List<String>{'org-one', 'org-two'}); System.assertEquals(true, removed[0]); System.assertEquals(true, removed[1]); System.assertEquals(false, Cache.Org.contains('org-one')); Cache.Session.put('session-one', 'one', 60); Cache.Session.put('session-two', 'two', 60, Cache.Visibility.NAMESPACE, false); Map<String,Boolean> sessionContains = Cache.Session.contains(new Set<String>{'session-one', 'session-missing'}); System.assertEquals(true, sessionContains.get('session-one')); System.assertEquals(false, sessionContains.get('session-missing')); Map<String,Object> sessionValues = Cache.Session.get(new Set<String>{'session-one', 'session-two'}); System.assertEquals('one', (String) sessionValues.get('session-one')); System.assertEquals('two', (String) sessionValues.get('session-two')); } }
